project_type: Nim DSL compiler and web framework (Doot) - compiles .do files to native binaries
build_system: nimble (Nim package manager). Compiler flags in nim.cfg: --threads:on --mm:orc. db_connector path configured in nim.cfg.
test_framework: Nim stdlib unittest module. Each test file is compiled and run independently with 'nim c -r tests/test_*.nim'. Some tests need --threads:on --mm:orc.
build_command: export PATH="/root/.nimble/bin:$PATH" && cd /projects/sandbox/Doot && nim c tests/test_router.nim
test_command: export PATH="/root/.nimble/bin:$PATH" && cd /projects/sandbox/Doot && nim c --threads:on --mm:orc -r tests/test_auth.nim
verification_instructions: 1. Compile the new test file: nim c --threads:on --mm:orc -r tests/test_auth.nim. 2. Run the full existing test suite to verify no regressions: nimble test. 3. Ensure all 469+ existing tests still pass.
setup_instructions: export PATH="/root/.nimble/bin:$PATH" (Nim 2.2.10 via choosenim). libargon2-devel and openssl-devel are installed at the system level. No nimble packages needed beyond stdlib and db_connector (which is bundled).
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET network mode. nimble packages from GitHub cannot be installed (the proxy doesn't forward arbitrary GitHub repos). Must use C FFI directly for OpenSSL HMAC and argon2. libargon2 is at /usr/include/argon2.h and /usr/lib64/libargon2.so. OpenSSL is at /usr/include/openssl/ with libssl and libcrypto.
contribution_requirements: Follow existing code patterns: ## doc comments at top, typed objects, procs with * for exports. Tests use stdlib unittest with suite/test blocks.
key_patterns: 1. Each module is a single .nim file in src/doot/. 2. Tests are in tests/test_*.nim. 3. AST nodes are object variants with NodeKind enum. 4. Server uses std/asynchttpserver. 5. DB uses db_connector/db_sqlite. 6. Session store already has SQLite CRUD (session.nim). 7. ctx.nim has DootCtx with currentUser: Row field. 8. router.nim has authRequired and roleName on Route objects. 9. server.nim has placeholder comments for Phase 5 auth wiring. 10. response.nim already has errorResponse(401/403) capability.
relevant_files: src/doot/session.nim - existing session store (CRUD, needs HMAC cookie signing added)
src/doot/server.nim - HTTP server (needs auth middleware wiring)
src/doot/ctx.nim - request context (has currentUser: Row, needs population)
src/doot/router.nim - route matching (already has authRequired, roleName fields)
src/doot/ast.nim - AST types (already has nkAuth with authRoles, emailVerification)
src/doot/db_types.nim - Row, DbValue types used for currentUser
src/doot/ddl.nim - DDL generation (needs user table DDL generation)
src/doot/query.nim - CRUD query interface (needed for user lookup)
tests/test_server_e2e.nim - pattern for E2E server tests with threads
directory_structure: src/doot/ - all source modules. tests/ - all test files (test_*.nim). docs/ - design docs including auth.md. examples/blog/ - sample app. nim.cfg - compiler config.
